items.summary: CFO recommendation: maintain containment-only execution and do not authorize new production work, spend, monetization, telemetry, requeues, or forecasts this cycle. Amazon reports $4.92 commission for 2026-09-21, but it is aggregate under tracking_id 'other' and cannot support site-level revenue claims; named site rows show clicks but $0 attributed commission. AI spend is $916.91 for 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-28 across 39 instrumented sites, including $143.69 for 0daynews.com, $98.55 for americastrikes.com, and $66.06 for blackmarketapparel.com. Contribution margin, ROI, payback, budget exposure, and cost-to-learn are not calculable because matching-period infrastructure, domains, labor, marketing, experiment, commitments, budget ceilings, and learning thresholds are missing. Continue only the existing period-aligned revenue, attribution, and cost reconciliation. Minimum measurement: site/content-level provider identifiers; a complete matching-period ledger for AI, infrastructure, domains, labor, marketing, experiments, and commitments; budget ceilings; and an explicit cost-to-learn threshold. Treat 14,410 impressions, 146 clicks, 1,002 sessions, 15 conversions, 36 awaiting measurement, and 3 proven outcomes as operating indicators—not financial results—and retain all growth opportunities as deferred backlog.

Continue work item 67ebb985-a7b8-47f4-9792-b4d727275c4a only. Preserve the $4.92 aggregate commission as unattributed, reconcile provider identifiers against recorded costs, and document missing budget ceilings, commitments, and learning thresholds. Do not infer site revenue, contribution margin, ROI, payback, budget capacity, forecasts, or causal lift.
